decks.notes: The deck revolves around generating mana and spell cost reduction with cards like Ruby Medallion and Desperate Ritual, while using Ral, Monsoon Mage and Wrenn's Resolve to draw through the deck and find combo pieces. Glimpse the Impossible and Reckless Impulse help to dig deeper into the deck, while Past in Flames allows for spells to be recast from the graveyard. The deck combines spells like Manamorphose, Pyretic Ritual, and Strike It Rich with Ral's ability to deal damage and generate mana to create a powerful storm combo. Valakut Awakening and Wish provide additional utility and card advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing a wide range of aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. With access to multiple colors of mana, the deck can efficiently cast a variety of powerful spells and creatures. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency and versatility to the deck. By combining fast creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu with powerful spells like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and end the game quickly.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It aims to maintain board control through cards like Static Prison and Goblin Bombardment while utilizing powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to pressure the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra element of flexibility to the deck. Additionally, cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and The One Ring provide additional ways to close out the game quickly. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Blood Moon to disrupt opponents' strategies.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the game using counterspells and removal spells, while also building up resources with cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The win condition is to ultimately play The One Ring, which can provide a powerful advantage and swing the game in your favor. The deck also includes various utility lands and other spells to help manage the opponent's board and maintain control until you are able to play your key cards and dominate the game.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Harbinger of the Seas and Murktide Regent. By using cards like Preordain and Consign to Memory to draw and control the opponent's hand size, this deck aims to establish board control and outvalue the opponent in the late game. The deck also utilizes graveyard hate with Cling to Dust and Sink into Stupor to further disrupt the opponent's strategy and secure victory through attrition.

This deck focuses on using ramping Eldrazi creatures and control spells to quickly accelerate mana production and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. By utilizing cards like Through the Breach and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game and maintain control of the board with cards like All Is Dust and Ugin's Labyrinth. The combination of Eldrazi creatures, ramp spells, and control elements creates a versatile and formidable strategy that can adapt to various situations in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Eldrazi Temple, Utopia Sprawl, and Emrakul, the Promised End to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as World Breaker and Breaker of Creation. In addition, it incorporates control elements like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect your own creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large Eldrazi creatures while maintaining control of the game through ramping and disruption spells.

The deck focuses on using Cascade spells (such as Shardless Agent and Ardent Plea) to cheat out powerful creatures like Generous Ent and Curator of Mysteries onto the battlefield for free. The goal is to fill up the graveyard with creatures using cards like Endurance and Street Wraith, then cast Living End to bring them all back at once, overwhelming the opponent with a board full of creatures. The deck also includes some control elements like Flare of Denial and Force of Negation to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines. By controlling the board state and preventing key spells from resolving, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and ultimately win the game through incremental advantage. The deck also includes some threats like Snapcaster Mage and Flame of Anor to pressure the opponent and close out the game once control has been established. Overall, the strategy revolves around controlling the game and outmaneuvering the opponent to secure victory.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on utilizing a powerful companion in Jegantha, the Wellspring to provide additional mana ramp and flexibility. The deck includes a mix of aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board and keep up the pressure on the opponent. Additional support comes from cards like Goblin Bombardment and Arena of Glory, creating a well-rounded strategy that aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly with ritual spells and Ruby Medallion to power out combo pieces like Ral, Monsoon Mage. It aims to cast past in flames to recast spells from the graveyard and generate an overwhelming advantage. The deck also utilizes Wish to tutor for specific combo pieces or answers as needed. Jegantha, the Wellspring is used as a companion to provide additional mana fixing and flexibility. The key strategy is to string together spells efficiently to create a storm of ruby-colored destruction.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through various forms of counter spells, removal, and card advantage. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's plans while building up resources and eventually taking control of the game with powerful threats like The One Ring and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The deck also utilizes card advantage engines like Teferi, Time Raveler and Meticulous Archive to stay ahead in the resource game. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the control elements and ensure smooth gameplay.

The main concept of this Ruby Storm deck is to generate a high amount of mana quickly through rituals and mana-generating spells in order to cast a large number of spells in a single turn. By utilizing Ral, Monsoon Mage and Glimpse the Impossible, the deck aims to draw through the deck rapidly, find key combo pieces, and eventually win the game through a storm of spells. The deck also utilizes Past in Flames to recur spells from the graveyard and maximize the potential of each card in the deck.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog. The deck aims to control the game through powerful counter magic and removal while slowly building advantage with card advantage engines like Archmage's Charm and Cling to Dust. By denying the opponent resources and answering threats efficiently, the deck seeks to grind out a win through attrition and outpacing the opponent's threats.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly through Eldrazi Temple and other mana sources to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Ulamog, Emrakul, and Kozilek. It also includes control elements such as Sowing Mycospawn and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Through the Breach allows for a quick jump-start to get Eldrazi creatures onto the battlefield. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big, hard-to-deal-with threats while maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays, utilizing a combination of creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By including Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, the deck gains additional mana acceleration. The mix of creatures like Amped Raptor and Orcish Bowmasters, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Galvanic Discharge, allows for early pressure and disruption. The deck also has a strong mana base with fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent color availability. Overall, the deck aims to close out the game quickly through a combination of creature damage and direct damage spells.
